notes:
POC scope + cost modeling notes (conversation snippets + AE/SE assumptions):
- POC ask: 3-week Dedicated POC in VPC; customer will run chat + embeddings + reranking workloads from staging traffic.
- Target SLAs: 95ms p95 for single-turn chat at 150 rps but willing to accept burst fallback to 250ms for non-critical flows. Throughput target: sustained 100–150 rps, spikes to 250 for morning batch.
- Preferred model family: open-weights transformer (quantized) validated for low-latency; fallback to smaller variant during degradation.
- Data controls: Strict KMS, audit logging retained 2 years, EU residency for subset of PII. Need SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence.

Cost modelling we walked through (AE/SE assumptions — internal sketch):
- Baseline reserved options discussed: 4xA100-equivalent (entry), 8xA100 (mid), 12xA100 (high availability / cross-shard).
- Unit price assumptions (internal): reserved GPU rate = $14/hr per GPU (committed monthly, enterprise discount applied).
- Utilization scenarios: low (40%), expected (65%), high (90%).
- Workload assumptions: average chat request = 1,000 input+output tokens; embeddings call average 2,000 tokens per batch; reranking small (200 tokens). Weighted token mix => ~800 tokens/request overall for blended workload.

Example per-token economics (back-of-envelope):
- 4-GPU monthly hours = 4 * 24 * 30 = 2,880 GPU-hours. Monthly cost @ $14/hr = $40,320.
- If utilization = 65% => billable inference-hours = 1,872 GPU-hours. Effective cost per GPU-hour used = $40,320 / 1,872 = $21.55 (amortized over idle time).
- Estimated tokens served per GPU-hour at observed batching/latency SLO = ~1.2M tokens/hour. => cost per 1K tokens = ($21.55 / 1,200) * 1000 = ~$17.96 per 1K tokens. (note: sensitive to batching efficiency and model size).
- At 8-GPU reserved, some linear scale but economies from higher batching and cross-request packing reduce effective cost per 1K tokens to estimated ~$11–13 per 1K tokens at 65% util.
- Adding Redwood Optimize caching + KV prefix cache expected to drop token throughput cost by ~20–35% for our chat-heavy flows (customer estimate).

Commercial asks from customer:
- 12-month commit with quarterly utilization re-eval and 10% true-up. Procurement wants price lock for 12 months and consumption tier discounts for >75% utilization.
- Wants SLA with clear remedies for p95 latency miss >2 occurrences/month. Proposed remedy: service credit scale tied to per-route SLO breaches.

Quotes / customer language captured:
- "We cannot tolerate black box autoscaling that shifts cost unexpectedly" — Head of Platform (call 2026-02-15).
- "If you can show unit economics at committed utilization we can push procurement" — Finance lead.

- Week 2: run hybrid traffic (embeddings + chat + rerank) with canary routing and KV cache enabled.
- Week 3: durability + failover test (simulate node loss, validate fallback model variant).
